# Fact-Loving Men Are Kept at a Distance by Idealism[^1]

Men who are strongly of the fact-loving temperament are liable to be kept at a distance by the small sympathy with facts which that philosophy from the present-day fashion of idealism offers them. It is far too intellectualistic.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
